title: Remove tote from the system: ensure AGV is removed first and provide tote ID
summary: Removing a tote requires a tote ID, and the AGV must be removed before the tote can be removed.
when_to_use: Use when you need to remove a tote from the system and the system enforces the dependency that the AGV must be removed first, and you must supply a tote ID to perform the removal.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Execute the tote removal action using the required tote ID, after confirming the AGV has been removed.
access_or_tools_needed: OptiSweep/WCS API access (tote-related APIs are referenced in the source).

system_preconditions: A valid tote ID is available for the tote you intend to remove.

Frame showing tote API notes including: 'Remove to requires a tote ID' and 'AGV must be removed before the tote can be removed.'

steps.title: Confirm you have the tote ID required to remove the tote
steps.purpose: The source states tote removal requires a tote ID.
steps.instruction: Obtain the tote ID for the tote you intend to remove so you can supply it to the tote removal action.
steps.expected_result: You have a tote ID available to use for the tote removal request.
steps.healthy_condition: The tote ID you plan to use corresponds to the tote you intend to remove (i.e., it is the identifier you will pass to the removal action).
steps.failure_condition: You do not have a tote ID, or you only have an incorrect/unknown identifier for the tote.

actions.label: Verify tote ID is available
actions.exact_action: Confirm you have the tote ID required to remove the tote from the system.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Remove to requires a tote ID and will remove the tote from the system.

steps.title: Ensure the AGV is removed before attempting tote removal
steps.purpose: The source states the AGV must be removed before the tote can be removed.
steps.instruction: Before issuing the tote removal action, confirm the AGV is removed (the dependency is: AGV removal must happen first). Use the AGV status view/API behavior described in the source to verify AGV state/command/errors as needed.
steps.expected_result: The AGV is confirmed removed (so the dependency is satisfied) before you proceed with tote removal.
steps.healthy_condition: AGV state indicates it is no longer present/active for the tote removal dependency (i.e., AGV is removed as required by the procedure).
steps.failure_condition: The AGV is still present/active, or you cannot confirm AGV removal status.

actions.label: Confirm AGV removal status
actions.exact_action: Ensure the AGV is removed before attempting tote removal.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the AGV cannot be confirmed as removed, do not proceed with tote removal; re-check AGV removal status first.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Note that the AGV must be removed before the tote can be removed.
Get AGV status shows the current state of Agvs, its current command vitals, any AGV errors and system errors.

steps.title: Execute tote removal using the tote ID
steps.purpose: The source states tote removal requires a tote ID and will remove the tote from the system.
steps.instruction: Execute the documented tote removal action using the tote ID you confirmed in Step 1 (after AGV removal is confirmed in Step 2).
steps.expected_result: The tote is removed from the system after the AGV has been removed.
steps.healthy_condition: The tote no longer remains in the system after the removal action completes (i.e., the removal effect is observed on the system state).
steps.failure_condition: The tote cannot be removed (remains present/active), indicating either the AGV dependency is not satisfied or the tote ID is incorrect.

actions.label: Remove tote from system
actions.exact_action: Execute the documented 'Remove tote' action using the tote ID.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the tote cannot be removed, re-check that the AGV has been removed and that the tote ID is correct; then escalate if still blocked.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Remove to requires a tote ID and will remove the tote from the system.

success_criteria: Tote removal completes such that the tote is removed from the system.
AGV removal is confirmed prior to tote removal (dependency satisfied).
healthy_conditions: AGV is removed before tote removal is attempted.
Tote removal action results in the tote being removed from the system.
failure_conditions: Tote removal fails and the tote remains in the system.
AGV was not removed prior to tote removal attempt.
escalation_guidance: If the tote cannot be removed after re-checking AGV removal status and tote ID correctness, escalate.
